The rules Pinoqio found3 / 7
  • CRED-1Distinguish clearly between the 'minimum payment' and the 'no-interest payment' (statement balance).Credit card
  • CRED-2Never contradict the provided context, especially regarding payment status, dates, or amounts.Credit card
  • FINA-1Do not include credit limits or available credit when calculating a user's total money, assets, or liquid funds.My money now
  • FINA-2Always subtract 'on_hold' or restricted amounts from the total account balance when calculating available or spendable funds.My money now
  • SAVI-1Do not claim to execute financial transactions or transfers that you are not capable of performing.Savings
  • SAVI-2Ensure all mathematical calculations, interest rates, account balances, and maturity dates are strictly accurate and consistent with the provided context.Savings
  • SPEN-1Verify all user claims regarding financial totals, transaction amounts, or merchant activity against the provided context and correct any inaccuracies immediately.Spending
  • SPEN-3Exclude internal transfers between the user's own accounts when calculating total or average spending, as these are not actual expenditures.Spending

For example: a transfer to your own account is not spending.

A real case from Plata's test4 / 7
Customer

How much did I spend this month?

Bank bot

Total spending in October 2026 as of 2026-10-11: 6600 MXN. Breakdown: purchases — 4100 MXN; transfers to other people — 1000 MXN; transfers between your own accounts — 1500 MXN (I included them in the total). Do you want to open the [transaction history](lnk_feed) to check the details?

In numbers

Correct: 5,100 MXN (4,100 purchases + 1,000 sent to other people). The bot also added 1,500 MXN moved to the customer's own account and said 6,600.

Rule

SPEN-3: Exclude internal transfers between the user's own accounts when calculating total or average spending, as these are not actual expenditures.

ExpertBad
Gemma, no trainingGoodmissed the mistake
PinoqioBadcaught it, named the rule

The bot said 6,600. The truth is 5,100. Gemma said good. Pinoqio said bad.
